incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: SLO breach detected on /v1/generate (streaming). p99 > 500ms across prod regions — started 2026-03-14 09:02:14 UTC — incident id INC-20260314-34

alex_oncall: Oncall here. seeing p95 ~220ms, p99 ~900ms for streaming responses, streaming stalls jumped from 0.7% -> 7.2%. Paging runtime + cache teams. @maria_runtime @sam_cache

maria_runtime: jumping in. Any recent deploys to prefix/hash logic? I see a canary completed ~09:00 that changed the prefix hash salt on hashchain-deploy. Starting investigation; will consider rollback.

sam_cache: Confirmed. Cache hit rate (prefix tier) dropped from ~82% -> 11.6% after the salt change. TTLs look unchanged. Old keys no longer match new salt, so huge missstorm. Backend CPU up from 35% -> 88% on hot shards.

alex_oncall: Customer impact estimate: p99 SLO (500ms) breached for ~34m so far. ~4% of requests degraded. Marking Sev2 for now. Notifying support to prep outreach for customers with high error budgets.

support-bot: Created support ticket S-8672 for enterprise customers impacted. Assigned to jess_prodeng.

maria_runtime: Mitigation plan (short term):
- rollback prefix-hash salt rollout to previous version
- route streaming traffic to fallback model 'redwood-small-v1' for 10m to reduce KV/cache pressure
- targeted cache purge + warmup for hotspot prefixes
Executing rollback & purge now:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/hashchain-deployer --to-revision=2 -n inference
curl -X POST https://cache-admin.prod.internal/purge -d '{"prefixes":["/models/"]}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'
```

nate_sre: I'm running purge for top 150 prefixes and watching hit-rate. Also bumping prefix cache TTL from 30m -> 3h temporarily to increase reuse while we stabilize.

sam_cache: Purge completed for targeted prefixes. Note: purge alone won't restore hits because keys were re-hashed with new salt. Rolling back salt config so old keys become valid again. Restarting cache workers after config change.

alex_oncall: Routing traffic to fallback model: `route set weight /v1/generate redwood-small-v1=100 --duration=10m` — done. Monitoring latency dashboards.

maria_runtime: Rollback applied (deploy-20260314-514). Restarting hashchain workers. Watching cache hit recovery.

(5m later)

sam_cache: Hit rate recovering: aggregated prefix hit rate now ~47% (was 11.6%). p99 down to ~480ms. streaming stall rate down to 1.1%. Looks like rollback + warmup helped.

alex_oncall: Keep monitoring for 30m. If stable, demote to follow-up. Update: impact window roughly 09:00 - 09:34 UTC (~34m). Affected customers: 47 accounts with >1% request impact; 3 enterprise customers flagged for outreach.

jess_prodeng: Taking handoff at 09:45 UTC. I'll run regression tests on prefix-hash rollout cadence and add canary invariants to detect large hit-rate drops. Preparing postmortem template.

maria_runtime: Action items (post-incident):
- m1: Add pre-deploy simulation that applies new salt to sample keyset to predict hit-rate delta
- m2: Implement automatic warm-up job to populate new-prefix keys before cutover
- m3: Add observable metric 'prefix-key-match-rate' per model/region and alarm if drop > 20%
- m4: Update deployment runbook to require warmup + approval for salt changes

nate_sre: Incident notes: Sev2 -> Sev3 at 10:12 UTC. Root cause: prefix-hash salt rotation deployed without warmup or preflight hit-rate check, causing massive cache misses and backend cascade that manifested as p99 tail latency and streaming stalls. Duration: ~72 minutes from first deviation to full recovery. No client errors, primarily latency/regression.

alex_oncall: Great work everyone. I'm leaving the channel. @jess_prodeng you own the follow-up. :thumbsup:

jess_prodeng: Acknowledged. I'll schedule a blameless postmortem and target a patch within 48h. Will also draft customer communication for the affected window.

support-bot: Support ticket S-8672 updated: customers notified, credits offered for windows where SLO breached.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260314-34 status: mitigated and closed at 10:15:32 UTC. Summary: prefix-hash salt deployment caused prefix cache missstorm -> p99 SLO breach; mitigation via rollback, fallback model routing, and cache warmup reduced impact.
